name: zvideo_dd_create_fullscreen_software_surfaces
description: zVideo_dd::CreateFullscreenSoftwareSurfaces creates the display, primary, and software DirectDraw surfaces for the fullscreen software path, initializes pixel packing, and attaches a DirectDraw clipper.
known_limits: VC5SP3 byte verification remains blocked by one fallback CreateSurface3FromDesc argument-scheduling cluster: verify vc5 0x4a8b20 reports 7 unmasked mismatches after 200 relocation-masked bytes and 11 trimmed VC NOP bytes.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a8b20 validates the GfxFlags option lookup, display surface CreateSurface3FromDesc descriptor with caps 0x0a00, LockSurfaceState/UnlockSurfaceState probe of the display surface, optional fallback display-surface recreation with caps 0x0200, primary and software surface descriptors sized from g_zVideo_DisplayModeSurfaceState, InitFullscreenSoftwarePixelPack on the display surface, DirectDraw CreateClipper, clipper SetHWnd(g_zVideo_hWnd), display-surface SetClipper, and ReportError line numbers 0x4cc, 0x4da, 0x4f7, 0x50d, 0x515, 0x519, and 0x51d for provider failures.
Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4a8b20 has no warnings and matches the implemented success-path provider call ordering, descriptor fields, global surface-state updates, and clipper binding.

The native smoke verifies the success path creates distinct display, primary, and software surfaces, probes display dimensions through LockSurfaceState/UnlockSurfaceState, initializes pixel packing from the display surface pixel format, creates and binds a DirectDraw clipper with g_zVideo_hWnd, sets the display surface clipper, clears the attached-backbuffer flag, and updates the expected surface-state globals.
